response.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t INNER JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC LIMIT 10
